notices.text: **Data credit.** The clock and core-count statistics above use Karl Rupp's [Microprocessor Trend Data, pinned snapshot](https://github.com/karlrupp/microprocessor-trend-data/tree/f2121ab2b83a156b114fe34e62e1edeca98e8e38/50yrs), under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).
